token=SELF-CONSISTENT (unanchored)
exit=4
class=PASS_UNANCHORED
# spec: 4.1 Type inference precedence
# note: 4.1 Money, `_` grammar: a separator is ignored once a digit has already
# note: appeared in the significand; it need NOT be immediately preceded by one.
# note: `1000._5` has four digits before the `_`, so it IS a monetary value and
# note: canonicalizes to `1000.5`. The previous revision read the rule as
# note: `immediately preceded` and sent this string to String, which hashes the
# note: package differently and exits 1 -- that is the divergence this case pins.
# note: Derived from the sentence, not from either binary's output.
# gap: SPEC-GAP-4.1-money-2
